headline: S&P Revises France Credit Rating Outlook to Negative on Budget Pressures
summary: S&P revised France's credit rating outlook to negative from stable, citing growing budget pressures as weak economic growth and higher interest costs make deficit reduction harder. INSEE reported a 0.1% third-quarter economic contraction.
why: Credit rating outlook revisions by major agencies like S&P can influence investor sentiment, borrowing costs, and sovereign debt yields for European nations.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: A negative outlook revision signals potential sovereign credit downgrades and increased borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: S&P's decision to lower France's rating outlook to negative reflects mounting concerns over the country's economic contraction and fiscal deficit, leading to downward pressure on French sovereign debt perception.
